scripts.build: pnpm --filter arqqbot-plugin-echo build && pnpm --filter arqqbot-plugin-persona-distill build && pnpm --filter @arqqbot/runtime build && pnpm --filter @arqqbot/desktop build && pnpm --filter @arqqbot/desktop build:web && pnpm --filter @arqqbot/server build
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @arqqbot/desktop exec electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.desktop:portable: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @arqqbot/desktop exec electron-builder --dir --config.directories.output=release-local && node scripts/launch-portable.mjs
